unresolved_components.title: Claim of a blanket August 2025 funding suspension covering Harvard, Yale, and Columbia
unresolved_components.reason: Supplied reporting documents separate March Columbia and April Harvard funding actions, but not a matching Yale action or joint blanket cutoff.
unresolved_components.missing_evidence: Direct evidence of a Yale action and authoritative details of the scope and date of any alleged joint suspension.

rationale: The supplied evidence supports separate Columbia and Harvard events but not the original three-university claim. No children are emitted pending validated event-specific drafts.
